description_en: Stone memorial pillar from 14th-16th century with an engraved stūpa.The artefact is located in the village of Tātopānī (Jarmī), above a track leading to a shrine of recent origin and at a few meters from a stone water tank.The pillar is oriented to the south, which may be its original orientation. Only the southern side is adorned. It is divided in three registers. At the bottom is a text in Nāgarī-related script of approximately 8 lines. The central register is occupied by the engraving of a stūpa. The stūpa is in turn surmounted by two circles and a heart-like motif. The inscription is very eroded. It is possible to discern some figures, but it remains difficult to make sense of them at they read 1(?)3112.Stone pillars were erected throughout the Karnali Basin from the 13th to the 17th century. They are installed to honor the memory of deceased persons, mostly warriors. In this case it would appear that the deceased was a Buddhist. Given the fact that stūpas are attested in the Karnali region between the mid-14th century and the early 16th century (Andolfatto 2019: 96-99), it is possible to propose that the Tātopānī pillar was erected during this time frame.The dimensions of the pillar are: 245 x 55 x 11 cm.
description_ne: जुम्लाको तातोपानी (जर्मी) गाउँमा अवस्थित यस शिलास्तम्भमा अभिलेख सहित एक चैत्य पनि कुँदिएको छ । हालै बनाइएको एक मन्दिर जाने बाटोको माथितिर रहेको ढुंगे पोखरीभन्दा केही मीटर पर यो स्तम्भ ठडिएको छ ।दक्षिणतिर फर्किएको यस स्तम्भको कुँदिएको भागलाई तीन तहमा बाँड्न सकिन्छ । दक्षिणपट्टिको यस भागको तल्लो अंशमा ८ लाइन जतिको अभिलेख छ । अभिलेखका अक्षरहरू भने पढ्न सकिने अवस्थामा छैन । अभिलेखको माथि एक चैत्यको आकृति रहेको छ भने त्यसमाथि गोलो दुई आकृति संगै एक अस्पष्ट आकृति कुँदिएका छन् ।कर्णाली भेगमा १३औं शताव्दीदेखि १७औं शताव्दीसम्ममा थुप्रै शिलास्तम्भहरू ठड्याइएका थिए । यस्ता स्तम्भहरू प्राय: मृत्यु भैसकेका व्यक्तिहरूको सम्झनामा स्मारकका रूपमा ठड्याउने चलन छ । विशेषगरि योद्धाहरूको सम्मानमा यस्ता स्मारकहरू बनाइन्छ । यो शिलास्तम्भ भने एक बौद्ध व्यक्तिको मृत्यु पछि ठड्याइएको हुनुपर्दछ । कर्णाली भेगमा स्तूप वा चैत्यहरू १४ औं शताव्दीको मध्यदेखि १६ औं शताव्दीको सुरुतिरको अवधिमा बनाइएको पाइन्छ (Andolfatto 2019: 96-99) । त्यसैले यो तातोपानी शिलास्तम्भ पनि सोही अवधिभित्र ठड्याइएको हुनुपर्दछ ।यस स्तम्भको नाप यसप्रकार छ: २४५ x ५५ x ११ से.मी.
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths), Surface damages

historical_events.event_description: Installation of the pillar at a date that remains difficult to ascertain since the second line of the inscription bears the figures 1(?)3112.
